2015 BRZ | Trim Levels 2015 BRZ | Specifications
Engine and Drivetrain BRZ
Power | Torque 2.0-liter DOHC aluminum-alloy 16-valve 4-cylinder horizontally opposed SUBARU BOXER®
engine with Dual Active Valve Control System (DAVCS).
200 hp @ 7,000 rpm | 151 lb-ft @ 6,400 rpm
Compression Ratio 12.5:1
Bore and Stroke 86.0 x 86.0 mm
BRZ Premium
Fuel System Direct and port fuel injection
• 200-hp direct-injected 2.0-liter 4-cylinder SUBARU BOXER® engine • Voice-activated 6.1-inch high-resolution touch-screen GPS navigation
Manual Transmission Close-ratio 6-speed manual
• Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission system and 8-speaker audio system with SUBARU STARLINK™ system
• Sport-tuned suspension featuring Aha™ connected service1, HD Radio® with iTunes® tagging, Automatic Transmission 6-speed electronic automatic transmission with Sport mode, and manual mode with paddle
• Multi-spoke 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels USB port/iPod® control, Bluetooth® audio streaming and hands-free shifters with rev-matching downshift control.
• HID headlights phone connectivity, SMS text messaging capability, SiriusXM® Satellite BRZ Premium and BRZ Series.Blue: Not Available. BRZ Limited: Optional.
• Cloth upholstery Radio and NavTraffic®2
Traction and Stability
• Manually adjustable air-conditioning system
Drivetrain Rear-wheel drive
Rear Differential Torsen® limited slip
Vehicle Stability Control (VSC) Includes Sport mode
Traction Control System (TCS)
Fuel
BRZ Limited Manual: 22/30/25 mpg Economy city/highway/combined4
Automatic: 25/34/28 mpg
Includes BRZ Premium key features and adds:
Fuel Requirement Premium unleaded gasoline (93 octane)
• Fog lights
• Trunk spoiler Fuel Capacity 13.2 gallons
• Alcantara® and leather-trimmed upholstery
• Heated front seats and side mirrors Chassis
• Dual-zone digital climate control
Steering Electric power-assisted quick ratio rack-and-pinion. Ratio: 13.1:1. Turns lock-to-lock: 2.48.
• Keyless Access with Push-button Start
Turning circle: 35.4 feet.
• Antitheft security system
Suspension Sport-tuned 4-wheel independent.
Front: Strut-type with lower L-arm. Stabilizer bar. Rear: Double wishbone. Stabilizer bar.
Brakes 4-wheel disc, ventilated front and rear. Dual-piston front and single-piston rear calipers.
4-channel, 4-sensor ABS with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD)
Brake Discs (front/rear) 11.6 inches/11.4 inches
Brake Assist When emergency braking is detected by how quickly the brake pedal is pressed, maximum
brake pressure is immediately applied.
BRZ Series.Blue3 Brake Override System If both brake and accelerator pedals are pressed simultaneously, the system reduces the
operation of the accelerator pedal to help prevent unintentional vehicle acceleration.
Includes BRZ Limited key features and adds:
• Limited availability (1,000 units) • Leather-wrapped steering wheel with blue leather accents and stitching Wheels and Tires
• 17-inch STI 15-spoke aluminum-alloy wheels with gloss black finish • Door trim with blue stitching
• Red-painted brake calipers • Center console and lower door knee pads with blue stitching Wheels BRZ Premium and BRZ Limited: 17 x 7.0-inch multi-spoke aluminum-alloy. Dark gray with
machine finish.
• Aerodynamic underbody covers • Shift boot and parking brake with blue stitching
BRZ Series.Blue: 17 x 7.0-inch STI 15-spoke alluminum-alloy. Gloss black finish.
• STI Aero Kit, including front, side and rear quarter under spoilers • Carpeted floor mats with BRZ logo and blue trim
• STI red start/stop ignition button • Frameless rearview mirror Tires 215/45 R17 87W summer-performance
• Carbon fiber-patterned dash trim
• Alcantara® and leather-trimmed front seats with blue Alcantara®/leather
bolster accents, embroidered BRZ logo and blue stitching
Standard Optional Not equipped
